Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: A student help request ticket in the classroom queue

studentName.description: Name of the student requesting assistance

tableNumber.description: Optional physical location or table of the student

category.description: Category or topic of the problem (e.g. JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Git)

description.description: Description of the student's issue or question

screenshotUrl.description: Optional base64 image data or image URL of error screenshot

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the help request

urgency.description: Urgency level of the help request

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when ticket was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when ticket was last updated

resolvedAt.description: Server timestamp when teacher resolved the ticket

studentUid.description: Optional UID of student if authenticated

ClassSession.title: ClassSession
ClassSession.description: Metadata and daily counters for the active class session

title.description: Title of the active class or workshop

courseCode.description: Optional course code or group identifier

teacherPasscode.description: Passcode required to unlock teacher control panel

totalTickets.description: Total counter of tickets generated in this session

resolvedTickets.description: Total counter of tickets successfully handled by teacher

/tickets/{ticketId}.description: Student queue tickets for the classroom
